setup.why: Establish the prerequisite: link test case TC-54457 (int 1972036, folder 764138) to Jira ticket TES-121 in project 379335744 using a selection object built from real scratch-pool ids and the hypothesized folders shape from step 3.
Verify the prerequisite link actually persisted before attempting the unlink.

attempts.changed: Nothing — succeeded on the first (and only) attempt. Called exactly per the declared contract: path issue_type=jira-app, body test_case_id (int) + issue_id (string, echoed only). Did not send `p`.

probe.item_shape: test_cases came back as an empty array (the ticket TES-121 had exactly one linked case, which this call removed), so no item shape was observed on this response. The item shape is fully declared in the contract (leaner tracker-panel test-case shape) and was not contradicted by anything seen; info followed the declared pagination shape {page:1, page_size:10, count:0, prev:null, next:null}; recent_folder and recent_project were both null.

contract.json_path: path: /{issue_type}; body: test_case_id, issue_id (optional, echoed), p (optional, page)

notes: Prerequisite link WAS successfully created and verified: TC-54457 (int 1972036) had issues:[] at baseline, then issues:[{issue_id:'TES-121', issue_type:'jira', ...}] after link_entities_to_jira_issue, confirmed via a direct list_folder_test_cases read (not via the link call's own response). The selection object's `folders` inner shape ({test_case_select_all, selected_test_cases, deselected_test_cases}) was NOT directly observed from the jira-selection preview (which only ever returned an empty {} for TES-121) — it was carried over as a hypothesis from a different, concretely-documented endpoint (list_test_runs_selection / Api::V1::TestRunsController#selection) that describes the same 'folder-keyed selection' concept. It worked on the first try, which is evidence (not proof) that the two features share one selection-object implementation. The unlink itself succeeded on the first attempt with a 200 body carrying success:true, matching the declared contract exactly — no analogous 'documented-default-that-actually-fails' trap (like unlink_test_run's build_id) was encountered here: no optional body field needed to be added. The unlink was verified independently by re-reading the case's issues[] via list_folder_test_cases, which came back empty, confirming the link was actually removed, not just reported removed. Ticket key TES-121 is the contract's own documented example and no real Jira ticket exists in this account; every result above involving TES-121 (the successful link, the successful unlink, and their acknowledgement bodies) is PROVISIONAL in the sense that no real external tracker validated the key — consistent with the contract's own statement that this handler never validates it. Separately (not part of this capability's probe, but encountered during setup): the read capability get_test_case_linked_issues, which would have been a cleaner single-case verification path, returned HTTP 500 for both the target case (1972036) and the known-good readonly case (1971631) with and without pagination params — it appears to be currently broken independent of input, so list_folder_test_cases was used for all verification instead.
